C0316.title: Zibo Police Dismantle Massive Illegal Social Account Registration and Trafficking Ring
C0316.summary: In May 2022, police in Zibo, Shandong province, dismantled a major operation involving the illegal registration and sale of social media accounts, arresting 71 suspects.
